correctness.rationale: The full four-row Fourier synthesis matrix is Parseval. Subtracting the erased-column contribution gives λ_min(S_E)=1−λ_max(Φ_E*Φ_E). Removing the diagonal phases gives NΦ_E*Φ_E=4I+B_E up to conjugacy, where the off-diagonals are the signed r_d evaluated on actual increasing-label differences. For the consecutive candidate, the odd eigenvector gives −b_N and the even sector gives x²−b_N x−2a_N²=0. Its positive root is the largest: b_N≥0 for N≥8, and at N=7 the independent certificate gives −b_N<2.91<β_N. For N≥11, r_2>6/5 by the cosine bounds in the proof; the positive main-lobe product 4 cos t cos(2t) decreases up to π/4, and the magnitude in the sidelobe is at most 8/(3√6), obtained by maximizing 4u(1−2u²). At N=10, r_2=1 and the remaining circular distances have magnitudes <1, 1, 0 for d=3,4,5 respectively. A nonconsecutive triple has at most one adjacent pair. Taking entrywise magnitudes in the Rayleigh quotient and comparing with the positive-off-diagonal matrices with entries (a,b,b) and (a,a,b) proves a strict Perron inequality since a>b>0. For N=7,8,9 an independent rational computation on unordered cyclic gap triples certifies s<6.34,8.01,10 and β_N>2.91,3.69,4.34 respectively. Here s is the sum of the three squared off-diagonals; trace zero and Cauchy–Schwarz on the other two eigenvalues give λ_max(B_E)²≤4s/3. The three strict rational gaps verify uniqueness in those orders. The Vandermonde property of any four retained columns proves the bound is positive, and the consecutive triple has exactly N distinct translates.
residual_risks: No claim for other row choices, erasure counts, or the whole erased spectrum as a function of the mask. Numerical enumeration in the frozen evidence was not used to prove the all-N comparison.

evidence: Barnett treats bounds on condition numbers of contiguous DFT blocks; Dirckx et al. compute singular values for such blocks. Batenkov et al. give clustered-node singular-value estimates under cluster and separation assumptions; Marshall–Waldron count harmonic-frame equivalence classes. The two-character Resultary result can use arbitrary erasure counts but fixes the dimension at two.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Knowing how ill-conditioned a contiguous block can be, computing its spectrum, or bounding clustered-node singular values does not prove that it is the strict maximizer of the largest erased-block eigenvalue among all three-site supports. Arbitrary erasure size for two frequencies does not dominate four frequencies.

evidence: 1b09479ce727 optimizes the same lower retained bound for modes 0,1,2 and lists the full spectrum only at that extremizer; it explicitly does not assert an upper-bound extremal theorem. At N=7 the four-mode frequency complement has three modes, but the complementary identity on the erased block changes maximum eigenvalue of the four-mode Gram to one minus minimum eigenvalue of the three-mode Gram. That is not the three-mode lower retained bound theorem.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Even the promising complement transformation at N=7 requires the opposite edge of the three-mode erased Gram spectrum to be optimized over all masks, not the winning-mask spectrum. For general N the complementary dimension also changes. The prior contiguous-block results evaluate the candidate or other objectives, not the needed off-candidate domination.

evidence: Minimizing retained λ_min is exactly maximizing the squared operator norm of the erased 4×3 partial DFT block; it also maximizes concentration on three sites in the four-mode subspace. The indexed three-mode records formulate their analogous result via lower frame bound, retained energy, or singular values, all with three rather than four fixed frequencies. Vaezi–Labeau find adverse consecutive rows/erasures for MSE or determinants, not this extremal singular value.

Closest three-mode and systematic DFT comparisons
value.rationale: This gives a sharp adversarial stability guarantee for a natural lowpass sampling frame: an exact lower squared singular value usable under three arbitrary losses, and a characterization of every worst mask. The normalization and the equality cases matter for comparing sample geometries. The four-frequency sidelobe and the separately certified small cyclic orders make this more than replacing a parameter in a three-frequency result or computing a single known contiguous block.
residual_risks: The usefulness is restricted to four consecutive frequencies and three losses. No general optimality claim for all frame designs or recovery objectives is made.
